主要内容: On January 6, 2015, Impac Mortgage Holdings, Inc. and its subsidiary, Impac Mortgage Corp., entered into an asset purchase agreement with CashCall, Inc.. IMC agreed to purchase substantially all of CashCall’s residential mortgage operations, which will operate as a separate division under the name CashCall Mortgage. The purchase price includes a fixed component of $10 million in cash and 500,000 newly issued shares, plus a contingent component based on a three-year earn-out of approximately 50% of pre-tax profits. The transaction is subject to conditions such as employee retention and no material adverse effect. The agreement may be terminated if obligations are not met by April 30, 2015.
